translations.web: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.
translations.bsb: “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
translations.kjv: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.
translations.asv: I will gather them that sorrow for the solemn assembly, who were of thee; to whom the burden upon her was a reproach.
